question: What powers are attained in this stage of practice, O beloved?
premises: Knowledge of distant hearing is named
These are presented as attained powers
inference: This stage yields knowledge of distant hearing and the power to paralyze bonds.
uncertainties: pāśa-stobham may imply arresting or immobilizing bonds or foes
plain_english: O beloved, one gains knowledge of hearing from afar and likewise the power to paralyze bonds.
